added_physical_caps.no_hidden_bound_inferred: No peak hidden force, hidden frequency cutoff or relaxation gap follows from energy. The plant must actually obey its LTI storage law over the operating range.

execution.limits: Floating ODE and expm; not laboratory or interval-validated source. PRNG emulation is not physical private entropy. Nonzero error allowances are robust contracts, not a complete perturbation simulation.

memory.protection_scope: Reliable finite classical arithmetic/storage/clock/control is supplied. A hardware-failure probability, protection work and power must be charged from an actual fault/hardware model; none is inferred from logical bits.
memory.streaming_buffer: one baseline, finite response table, counters and control program

off_mode_extensions.constant_unknown_bias: Use Esharp=E-f0*x+f0^2/(2mu), with supplied or derived Esharp_initial <= (sqrt(E_initial)+abs(f0)/sqrt(2mu))^2. Then Esharpdot<=-v^2 in fixed off mode and incremental inputs retain S.
off_mode_extensions.executed_scope: Primary exact fixed-center idle; extensions were not injected in the nominal simulation.
off_mode_extensions.time_varying: Failure <= 2 E D/(N delta^2)+xi0^2 D^2/delta^2 for a common private-index-independent counterfactual; reallocate energy, N, sensor range and delivery, not just waiting.

physical_resources.hardware_scope: Permanent spring; its reaction is bounded by energy. Known mass also bounds the local damper reaction. Bare law and hidden modes are not supplied to the learner.
physical_resources.off_mode: exact fixed center in primary illustration
physical_resources.off_mode_extension: Nonzero common off error must meet the separate floor and energy ledger in universal_physical_closure.md.
physical_resources.readiness_scope: Includes only quiet drift, baseline metrology/noise and baseline-only backaction. Forecast force/backaction is separate in delivery_error_exact.
physical_resources.relative_program_timing_scope: Within-program error <=1e-8 and command tracking/gain/rounding together must fit the 1e-5 force error. Absolute slot/report timestamp tolerance is separately 1e-6.

status: Executed floating retained source and exact finite report encoding; physical hardware contracts explicit.
